title: Genome Governance Token for AI Agents

constraints.must: The agent shall not attempt to recontact the data subject, family members, or named points of contact.
All copies of the underlying biodata shall be deleted within 30 days of programme close. Revocation is immediate. Erasure is biofs erase.
Research outputs (code, methods, ranked variant lists, reports) are released under CC BY 4.0. The underlying genome, FASTQ, VCF, and BAM are not.
This grant is not medical care, diagnosis, or treatment. Purpose code is research (1001), never clinical-use (1002). BioPIL 5 (gdpr-research), not BioPIL 7 (clinical-use).
